text_en: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the judgment of the great whore who is seated on many waters,
text_cn: 那七位拿着七个盂的天使中，有一位前来，向我说道：“你来，我要指给你看，那在多水之旁为王的大淫妇受的惩罚；

text_en: with whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and with the wine of whose fornication the inhabitants of the earth have become drunk. ”
text_cn: 世上的诸王都同她行过邪淫，地上的居民也都喝醉了她淫乱的酒。”

text_en: So he carried me away in the spirit into a wilderness, and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was full of blasphemous names, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
text_cn: 于是天使叫我神魂超拔，提我到了旷野，我便看见了一个妇人，坐在一只朱红色且满了亵渎名号的兽身上，它有七个头，十只角。

text_en: The woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and jewels and pearls, holding in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her fornication;
text_cn: 这妇人身穿紫红和朱红色的衣服，全身点缀着金子、宝石和珍珠；她手里拿着满盛可憎之物和她淫污的金杯。

text_en: and on her forehead was written a name, a mystery: “Babylon the great, mother of whores and of earth’s abominations. ”
text_cn: 她的额上写着一个含有奥秘的名字：“伟大的巴比伦！淫乱和地上可憎之物的母亲。”

text_en: And I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and the blood of the witnesses to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly amazed.
text_cn: 我又看见这妇人痛饮了圣徒的血，和为耶稣殉道者的血；我一看见她，遂大为惊奇。

text_en: But the angel said to me, “Why are you so amazed? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast with seven heads and ten horns that carries her.
text_cn: 天使便对我说：“你为什么惊奇？我要告诉你这妇人和驮着她，而有七个头和十只角的那兽的奥秘：

text_en: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to ascend from the bottomless pit and go to destruction. And the inhabitants of the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will be amazed when they see the beast, because it was and is not and is to come.
text_cn: 你所看见的那兽，先前在而今不在，可是它又要从深渊中上来，自趋于丧亡；地上居民，凡他们的名字从创世之初，没有记录在生命册中的，看见那先前在，而今不在，将来又在的兽，都必要惊奇。

text_en: “This calls for a mind that has wisdom: the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman is seated; also, they are seven kings,
text_cn: 这里需要一个有智慧的明悟去理解：七个头是指那妇人所坐的七座山，也是指七位君王；

text_en: of whom five have fallen, one is living, and the other has not yet come; and when he comes, he must remain only a little while.
text_cn: 五位已经倒了，一位仍在，另一位还没有来到；当他来到时，必要存留片刻。

text_en: As for the beast that was and is not, it is an eighth but it belongs to the seven, and it goes to destruction.
text_cn: 至于那先前在而今不在的兽，是第八位，也属于那七位中之一，它要趋于丧亡。

text_en: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but they are to receive authority as kings for one hour, together with the beast.
text_cn: 你所看见的那十只角，是指十个君王，他们还没有领受王位，但必要同那兽一起得到权柄；他们当国王，只一个时辰。

text_en: These are united in yielding their power and authority to the beast;
text_cn: 他们的意见都一致：就是把自己的能力和权柄都交给那兽。

text_en: they will make war on the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with him are called and chosen and faithful. ”
text_cn: 他们要同羔羊交战，羔羊却要战胜他们，因为他是万主之主，万王之王，同他在一起的蒙召、被选和忠信的人，也必要获胜。”

text_en: And he said to me, “The waters that you saw, where the whore is seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and languages.
text_cn: 天使又对我说：“你看见那淫妇所统治的水，是指诸民族、群众、邦国和异语人民。

text_en: And the ten horns that you saw, they and the beast will hate the whore; they will make her desolate and naked; they will devour her flesh and burn her up with fire.
text_cn: 你看见的那十只角和那兽，必要憎恨那淫妇，使她成为孤独凄凉，赤身裸体的，并吞食她的肉，且用火焚烧她，

text_en: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out his purpose by agreeing to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God will be fulfilled.
text_cn: 因为天主使它们的心中有这意念，叫它们实行天主的计划，就是叫它们一心，把它们的王权交给那兽，直到天主的话完全应验为止。

text_en: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth. ”
text_cn: 你所看见的那妇人，是指那座对地上的诸王握有王权的大城。”
